public_rationale: OpenAI documented using production material in training, so Marcus identified a real contamination concern. But the claimed destruction of testing ability goes further. The API excluded submissions from training by default, and GPT-4 offered a fixed March version. Together, these provided a documented route for testing private cases created after that version was fixed. That conclusion is an inference from the documented testing arrangements; it does not establish that existing benchmarks were uncontaminated.
limitations: API access was initially restricted by a waitlist.
Fixed-version testing does not reveal the training corpus or validate broad claims of general intelligence.
A softer reading of 'killing' as undermining confidence would merit a different assessment.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI's incorporation of user experiments into its training corpus destroys the scientific community's ability to test whether its models generalize to new cases.

statement.excerpt: Worse, as Ernie Davis told me yesterday, OpenAI has begun to incorporate user experiments into the training corpus, killing the scientific community’s ability to test the single most critical question: the ability of these models to generalize to new test cases.
statement.document_title: The Sparks of AGI? Or the End of Science?

from_speaker: OpenAI has begun to incorporate user experiments into the training corpus
killing the scientific community’s ability to test
our_interpretation: The claim concerns testing options available when the post appeared, especially for GPT-4.
I read 'killing' as making credible fresh-case testing unavailable, rather than merely making reused benchmarks harder to interpret.
A documented route using a fixed model version and newly created private cases can contradict the claimed impossibility. It need not establish that the model generalizes successfully.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes that user experiments entered training and that this prevented researchers from conducting credible tests on genuinely new cases.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous documentation or independent experiments establish a workable route for testing new cases despite the collection of other users' material.
